name: Umbraline PhoneShell PS-X 'Last Call'
description:
A phone case with an integrated stun system that delivers a 70,000-volt discharge through electrode contacts on the case's outer edges. The PS-X fits standard smartphone form factors and adds only 4mm of thickness to the device, passing casual inspection as a ruggedized protective case. The electrodes are concealed within the case's textured grip ridges — invisible until activated by a specific grip pattern (squeeze both sides and press the volume button simultaneously).

Umbraline designed the PS-X around the observation that the smartphone is the one object always in a person's hand during a street encounter — victims instinctively clutch their phone when threatened, making it the ideal platform for a concealed defensive tool. The case's grip-pattern activation prevents accidental discharge during normal phone use, and the electrode placement ensures the phone's screen and touchscreen functionality are unaffected.

The PS-X costs Φ160 and is available for fifteen popular smartphone models. It recharges independently from the phone via a micro-USB port on the case's bottom edge, providing thirty discharges per charge. Umbraline is a small GLMZ company that has built its entire product line around the principle of defense through everyday objects — the PS-X is their bestseller, accounting for seventy percent of revenue. The product has been copied extensively, with counterfeit versions of varying quality flooding lower-tier markets.
base_technologies: Concealed electrode integration in consumer electronics housing
specifications:
voltage: 70,000V
amperage: 3.8 milliamps
electrode location: concealed in grip ridges
activation: bilateral squeeze + volume button
discharges per charge: 30
charging: micro-USB, independent from phone
added thickness: 4mm
weight: 42 g (case only)
compatible models: 15 popular smartphone form factors
cost: Φ160
tactical_use: When threatened, shift to the activation grip pattern while the phone is already in your hand. The transition from normal phone grip to activation grip takes less than one second with practice. Press the electrified edge of the case against the attacker's exposed skin. The concealed nature of the weapon provides a significant advantage — the attacker does not perceive the phone as a threat and may allow it within striking distance. Optimal targets: hands reaching for you, forearms, neck.
cultural_context: The PS-X has tapped into a truth about modern life in GLMZ: the phone is always there. By weaponizing the most ubiquitous object in daily life, Umbraline has created a defense tool with zero carry burden — it is already in your hand. The product has been particularly successful among younger demographics who view carrying a separate defense device as inconvenient but are never without their phone. 'Call for help' has acquired a double meaning in neighborhoods where PS-X cases are common.
story_hooks: A PS-X discharge during a mugging attempt shorted out the victim's phone, erasing encrypted data that turned out to be evidence in a corporate whistleblower case — the mugger may have been sent specifically to destroy that data under cover of a street crime.

Umbraline's factory has been infiltrated by a competitor who is subtly sabotaging production — PS-X units from certain batches have a critical flaw that causes the electrode discharge to feed back through the phone's touchscreen, shocking the user.

physical_description.visual_profile: A slim, protective smartphone case with a subtly aggressive aesthetic. At first glance, it reads as premium protective gear — businesslike and utilitarian. The textured grip ridges running vertically down both sides are the only hint of its dual purpose, creating a faintly tactical appearance beneath the veneer of consumer tech accessory.
physical_description.dimensions: Approximately 15.5cm height × 7.8cm width × 0.8cm depth (case only, fitted to standard smartphone form factor). Adds negligible bulk to any contemporary mobile device.
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and hand-friendly at 42 grams — light enough to feel like standard protective gear, with subtle weight distribution that places the stun capacitors' mass near the grip ridges. Feels confident in hand without revealing its purpose.
physical_description.primary_material: High-impact thermoplastic polymer (TPE) composite base with reinforced edges. Internal conductive mesh embedded within grip structure. Micro-USB charging port discretely integrated into bottom edge.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal black with brushed texture throughout. The grip ridges feature a finely crosshatched pattern that mimics rubberized traction ridges but actually houses the electrode contacts. No shine or gloss — deliberately understated.
physical_description.color_scheme: Flat charcoal black primary with gunmetal gray accent lines tracing the electrode pathways beneath the surface texture. Minimal branding in muted silver foil.
physical_description.grip_texture: Deeply textured crosshatch polymer with microridges that feel like premium industrial grip tape. The ridges are intentionally pronounced to suggest ruggedness while concealing electrode contacts. Slightly tacky grip ensures confident handling during normal phone use and during activation sequence.
distinctive_features: Nearly invisible electrode contact points hidden within grip ridge texture
Micro-USB charging port (bottom edge, flush-mounted) separate from phone's charging system
Minimal LED indicator (single pale blue light, concealed beneath top edge) blinks when fully charged
Precisely molded grip ridges that align electrode contacts with palm edges and fingertips at optimal contact points
Perfectly flush screen cutout — no raised bezel that might hint at internal complexity
Volume button pass-through with subtle pressure-point marking (nearly undetectable to untrained eye)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: UMBRALINE PERSONAL DEFENSE etched in tiny serif capitals (3mm high) on the bottom rear edge. Serial number printed on interior case lip. Discreet radioactive trefoil symbol (2mm diameter) near charging port indicating electrical component. Genuine units feature a holographic authenticity seal on the interior back panel.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine and presentable in formal market. Field units show minor cosmetic wear — micro-scratches on edges, slight discoloration of grip ridges from sweat and oil contact, occasional dust accumulation in texture. Even well-used examples maintain their deceptive appearance as standard protective cases. Counterfeit versions often have rough texturing, inconsistent grip ridge depth, and visible electrode contact points.
